Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Heavy-Traffic Queuing Principles (or Queuing Dynamics / Queuing Theory)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Checkpoint wait times and delays scale quadratically with passenger arrival variance ($C_a^2$) as checkpoint utilization approaches capacity ($\rho \to 1.0$).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Prompts qualitative committee members to ask where the physical conservation laws or Navier-Stokes equations are; passengers are human travelers making cognitive choices.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Deterministic Operational Baseline
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Published airline flight schedules shifted forward in time across empirical ACRP Report 40 passenger arrival distributions ($t+1, t+2, t+3$).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Physical baseline" implies physical sensor modeling or physics-informed neural networks rather than schedule-driven terminal planning.

Draft_Jargon_or_Coined_Term: Physical Ebb and Flow / Physical Rules
Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Operational Ebb and Flow / Deterministic Operational Rules
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Concentrated surges and valleys in security arrivals caused by hub-and-spoke airline flight departure banks.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Conflates airline bank scheduling and passenger habits with physical forces or mechanics.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: True Empirical Lead-Lag Relationship (or Operational Lead-Lag Offset)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: The observed time gap between when passengers clear security (90–120 min prior) and when flights push back from gates.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: It is an empirically observed behavioral timeline in aviation data, not a physical law of nature.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Idiosyncratic Terminal Layouts and Gate Configurations
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Unique concourse layout, pier shapes, checkpoint locations, and gate distributions at an individual airport.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Physical geometry" sounds like CAD engineering or fluid domain meshing rather than airport terminal planning.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Facility and Aircraft Features (or Terminal Operational Features)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Screening lane counts, checkpoint configurations, aircraft seat gauge, route load factors, and connecting ratios.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Over-emphasizes "physics" when referring to operational and equipment characteristics of commercial aviation.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Carrier Isolation Structurally / Operationally Impossible
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Consolidated central checkpoint halls (such as Salt Lake City) where all airlines mix into a single passenger screening line.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: It is an architectural and operational design choice of the terminal, not an impossibility under physical laws.

Draft_Jargon_or_Coined_Term: Physical Checkpoint Closures vs. Missing Sensor Data
Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Scheduled Checkpoint Closures vs. Missing Sensor Data (or Nighttime Closures)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Zero throughput recorded between 00:00 and 04:00 because checkpoints are closed overnight by TSA policy.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Conflates administrative operating schedules with physical phenomenon; "sensor dropouts" implies faulty hardware.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Dynamic Two-Stage Hybrid Model (or Sequential Two-Stage Hybrid)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: A sequential model coupling recurring daily flight schedule cycles with live prior-hour error feedback ($e_{t-1}$) from checkpoint turnstiles.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Cyber-physical" refers to robotics, industrial SCADA systems, or IoT embedded hardware; using it for a statistical model is buzzword inflation.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Two-Stage Sequential Architecture / Closed-Loop Error Adaptation
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Updating forecasts dynamically using live floor feedback during severe flight delays to avoid demand collapse.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Manifolds" is borrowed from differential geometry and topology, sounding like pseudo-mathematical obfuscation.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Dual-Track Operational Decision Framework (or Disruption-Adaptive Checkpoint Forecasting Playbook / Regime-Adaptive Predictive Architecture)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: An automated operational decision rule routing predictions to Model 2 (Supervised ML) during calm conditions and switching to Model 3 (Dynamic Hybrid) during severe disruptions ($T(h) \ge 0.75$).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Gated" and "inference engine" are computer science / AI runtime jargon; "gates" also conflicts with physical airport boarding gates.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Landside–Airside Volatility Interaction Term (or Joint Volatility Interaction)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Compounding operational stress when passenger arrival surges ($CV_{\text{TSA}}$) coincide with high flight departure delay dispersion ($\sigma_{\text{Delay}}$).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Coined, proprietary acronym not found in FAA/IATA literature; multiplies mixed units (dimensionless ratio $\times$ delay minutes).

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Bivariate Volatility Stratification (or Cross-System Volatility Regimes)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Grouping operational days by both landside passenger variation ($CV_{\text{TSA}}$) and airside flight delay spread ($\sigma_{\text{Delay}}$).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Sounds like an invented mathematical artifact rather than standard bivariate statistical clustering.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Bimodal Intraday Operational Peaks: Morning Surges and Evening Delay Cascades
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Daily bimodal congestion curve: morning passenger arrival rush (05:00–08:00) and evening flight delay propagation (14:00–22:00).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Diurnal" is ecology jargon; "non-consecutive" overcomplicates a standard bimodal curve; "turbulence" borrows fluid physics jargon.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Intraday Operational Congestion Index (or Operational Stress Index)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Formula classifying hours of the day into Off-Peak, Mid-Peak, and Peak congestion blocks.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Turbulence Shock Index" sounds like aeroelastic flutter or fluid mechanics rather than queuing congestion.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Real-Time Prior-Hour Error Correction (or Live Prior-Hour Forecast Error Feedback)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Raising this hour's forecast if the model underpredicted last hour because delayed passengers crowded the terminal.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Innovation" sounds like corporate buzzwords; "1-step" is abstract algorithm speak for "prior-hour."

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Strict Information Causality (or Preserving Operational Information Availability)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Models only ingest information knowable before the forecast hour, using prior-hour delays rather than same-hour delays.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Lookahead leakage" is Kaggle data science competition jargon rather than formal econometric causality terminology.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Operational Partition Demarcation with Purge Buffers (or Chronological Demarcation)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Contamination along the chronological time axis across evaluation partitions (e.g., random k-fold cross-validation shuffling or global normalization across test sets).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Fails to distinguish structural time-axis partition errors from feature-space covariate leakage; sounds like informal competition jargon.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Strict Information Causality in Covariate Construction (or Lagged Covariate Ingestion)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Ingesting realized, post-event operational states (e.g., actual departure delays, pushback timestamps) that are physically unknown at forecast time $t$.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Conflates planned flight schedules with realized downstream operations; creates models that collapse during live airport deployment.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Empirical Passenger Show-Up Curve Convolution (or Lead-Lag Arrival Distribution)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Spreading departing flight seats across 1, 2, and 3 hours prior to takeoff based on empirical ACRP Report 40 arrival timing.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Passengers do not follow continuous physics kernels; they follow empirical behavioral timing (90 to 120 minutes prior to departure).

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Connecting Passenger Deflator (or Local Originating Passenger Fraction)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Multiplying flight seats by $(1 - \text{Connecting Ratio})$ to remove passengers who connect airside and never enter TSA security.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Calling a simple subtraction and multiplication a "manifold" is pretension that invites immediate committee challenge.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: The Hub Disconnect (or Connecting vs. Local Originating Disconnect)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: The planning error of assuming every departing airline seat corresponds to a passenger entering landside security.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Paradox" sounds melodramatic for a well-known airline hub transfer phenomenon.

Draft_Jargon_or_Coined_Term: Type I (Air-Gapped) vs. Type II (Airside Connected) Complexes
Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Physically Separate Terminals vs. Walkway-Connected Terminals
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Standalone terminal buildings (LGA, DTW) versus terminals connected airside by post-security pedestrian walkways (DFW, LAX).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Type I/II" is idiosyncratic labeling; "air-gapped" is cybersecurity jargon borrowed from network engineering.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Post-Security Terminal Cross-Over
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Passengers who clear TSA security at Terminal A and walk post-security to board a departure out of Terminal B.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Leakage" and "cross-contamination" are chemical/microbiological terms that sound inappropriate in passenger transport.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Nominal On-Time Baseline (or Overnight Low-Demand Period)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: On-time flight operations (delay < 15 min, 0 cancellations) used as a control state, or overnight curfew hours.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Quiescent" is biology/laboratory jargon; "sterile control" confuses medical sterilization with FAA sterile concourses.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Routine Operational Accuracy (Robustness)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: How consistently and accurately a predictive model forecasts during normal, undisturbed commercial flight banks.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Static stability" is flight dynamics terminology (longitudinal stability derivatives); confuses aerodynamics with forecast accuracy.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Prospective Chronological Holdout Evaluation Matrix (or Temporal Holdout Benchmark Matrix)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Evaluating frozen models strictly forward in time on an unobserved future calendar year (2025) after training on historical operations (2022–2024).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Sounds like "running out of clock time" on an exam or an algorithmic compute timeout, rather than prospective chronological evaluation.
